page_title: CAG 0-1 ACM | Cagliari v AC Milan 02/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) jumps into a tackle and Rosario Abisso signals a foul.
90+1' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+1' Rosario Abisso rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan).
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Modric (AC Milan).
90' Luka Modric (AC Milan) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Elia Caprile to dive and make a save.
89' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call. AC Milan are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
87' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

87' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Elia Caprile shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Now AC Milan have a corner.
86' Some patient build-up play from AC Milan as they look to unlock the defence.
83' Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
83' It's time for a substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on in place of Semih Kilicsoy.
83' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli did his best and is replaced by Nicolo Cavuoti (Cagliari).
79' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) replacing Pervis Estupinan.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch for Ruben Loftus-Cheek.
76' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
73' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
73' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) commits a foul and Rosario Abisso immediately signals a free kick.
73' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
71' The resulting corner from Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is cleared.
71' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. Cagliari have a corner.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch so that Youssouf Fofana can be given a rest.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafael Leao leaves the pitch and Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) comes on.
66' Fabio Pisacane is forced to make a change. Sebastiano Esposito is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
65' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) picks up an injury.
65' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and it's Rafael Leao (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
63' PENALTY APPEAL after Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
61' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
61' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) replaces Matteo Prati.
60' The ball is cleared after Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Substitution. Adam Obert makes his way off the pitch and Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
59' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the top left corner, but Elia Caprile is alert and thwarts the effort.
59' Poor challenge! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is penalised for tripping and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle.
58' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
56' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The game is interrupted as Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is flagged offside.

54' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Rosario Abisso with no other option than to blow for a foul.
52' Rosario Abisso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.
50' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was set free in the area by Adrien Rabiot and fired past Elia Caprile. 0:1.
49' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
46' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the corner but it's cleared.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is caught offside!
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Rosario Abisso no option but to blow his whistle.
42' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
41' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Koni De Winter (AC Milan) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
34' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared.
33' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marco Palestra (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.
32' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mike Maignan makes a comfortable save.
31' The possession of the ball – 45:55.
29' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

28' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Koni De Winter (AC Milan). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
28' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
25' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Elia Caprile comes off his line to intercept.
21' Cagliari hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
19' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
17' A long pass finds Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
15' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play.
13' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

13' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.
12' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
10' The resulting corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
6' Adam Obert (Cagliari) brings an opponent down and Rosario Abisso interrupts the game.
4' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
3' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
2' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
1' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Cagliari will kick-off.
Rosario Abisso will supervise the game today.
